text:
on lying to yourself / "load-bearing delusions" / self-deceit

all human interaction gets a lot easier when u stop expecting people to be rational

they’re not, I’m not, no one is

literally the only guarantee is that 100% of humans u meet, will all be wildly irrational.

doesn’t mean some of them aren’t wonderful ppl, ones that u can objectively build great relationships with

but, eventually u will bump into some birds nest of lies, voluntary self-deceit and "load-bearing delusions" -- things that they need to believe about themselves in order to make it through the day.

do not argue. do not try and change them. do not attempt to reconfigure any of this wiring.

for most ppl, this vast edifice of pretzelthought, the tangled web they've weaved of rationalizations and pleasant falsehoods...its all that is supporting their continued existence

they would be reduced to a puddle otherwise

u may be tempted to pull blocks out of this jenga tower. do not do it

what u want to do, is find the people who have broken down these barriers.

they tend to stand out; they are fiercely at war with themselves and aggressively hacking and slashing a machete thru their pile of "lies I used to tell myself."

these individuals can handle u telling them the truth about themselves.

as for everyone else, Pascal already made it known...telling people the truth about themselves is the fastest way, 100% guaranteed, to make them hate ur fuckin guts.

load-bearing delusions are not to be disturbed

sometimes the most polite and empathic route is to feign ignorance

sometimes the optimal path forward -- for both parties -- is simply for u to "see no, hear no, speak no"

and while u can see very clearly what would fix them, u will learn firsthand:

most people don't actually want to be fixed.
